title: Manyhands JSON v1 setup poll
description: The data of a poll once of a repository whose first-time setup is pending: what the poll saw of the setup on the remote's primary, and, on activated, the merged mode. Every outcome is an ok answer and the request is finished: a stop is final and a new request polls again. It holds no remote location, credential or identity.

type.description: Always setup_poll: the tag that tells this data from every other command's.

outcome.description: What the poll saw, in the order it checks: not_published (the setup is recorded and not on the remote yet, and nothing was connected to), configuration_invalid or primary_differs (the remote's primary holds a configuration that cannot be read or names another primary branch), branch_deleted (the setup branch is gone and the primary does not hold the setup), waiting_for_merge, waiting_for_checkout (the root is not on the primary, or not clean, or the setup branch is checked out in a worktree), diverged (the local primary has commits the remote's lacks) and activated (the primary was fast-forwarded and the repository is set up).

integration.description: The merged mode on activated, null otherwise.

differs.description: True when the merged file is not the one the setup intended; the merged one is in effect.
